description: 360° machine snapshot at the exact millisecond clicked from Process Timeline. Shows job context, physical variables, PE alignment, Cpk, and alarm proximity.

list.name: scope_filter
list.label: Event Timeline Scope
list.query: This Machine Only : machine,Fleet Wide : fleet

list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT factory AS __text, factory AS __value FROM public.ldi_data ORDER BY factory

list.name: machine_id
list.label: Machine
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ((${clicked_series:sqlstring} <> '__none__' AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)) OR (${clicked_series:sqlstring} = '__none__' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})))
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id AS __text, eqp_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE ((${clicked_series:sqlstring} <> '__none__' AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)) OR (${clicked_series:sqlstring} = '__none__' AND factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}))) ORDER BY eqp_id

list.name: mo
list.label: MO
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT mo AS __text, mo AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)
ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT mo AS __text, mo AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY mo

list.name: log_id
list.label: Event Log ID
list.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT log_id AS __text, log_id AS __value FROM public.ldi_data WHERE eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 THEN ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))) ELSE 0 END, "time" DESC
  LIMIT CASE WHEN ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 500 END
)
SELECT * FROM v
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v)

/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", state AS "State", mo AS "Job (MO)", fpn AS "Part (FPN)", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board", filmno AS "Film", resist AS "Resist", scale_mode AS "Scale Mode", "time" AS "Timestamp" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE log_id = (COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1

 ROUND(pe_5::NUMERIC,3) AS "PE 5",ROUND(pe_6::NUMERIC,3) AS "PE 6",

 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(

panels.title: ◈ Process Capability (PE & JE) — Worst Cpk
panels.description: Combined PE + JE process capability for the selected machine(s)/event. Worst Cpk = LEAST(Cpk PE, Cpk JE); Confidence flags LOW SAMPLE when the deciding sample count is below 30, NO_DATA when neither PE nor JE produced samples.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_machines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id=split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})))
), pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.pe_setting,p.pe FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), pe_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) n_pe,AVG(pe) mean_pe,STDDEV_SAMP(pe) stddev_pe,AVG(pe_setting) pe_lim FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), pe_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_pe,
    pe_lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0) AS cp_pe,
    LEAST((pe_lim-mean_pe)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0),(mean_pe+pe_lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0)) AS cpk_pe
  FROM pe_stats
), je_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.je_setting,j.je FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND j.je IS NOT NULL AND d.je_setting IS NOT NULL
), je_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) n_je,AVG(je) mean_je,STDDEV_SAMP(je) stddev_je,AVG(je_setting) je_lim FROM je_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), je_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_je,
    je_lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0) AS cp_je,
    LEAST((je_lim-mean_je)/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0),(mean_je+je_lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0)) AS cpk_je
  FROM je_stats
), combined AS (
  SELECT sm.eqp_id, p.n_pe, p.cpk_pe, j.n_je, j.cpk_je
  FROM selected_machines sm
  LEFT JOIN pe_capability p ON p.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id
  LEFT JOIN je_capability j ON j.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id
), worst AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN cpk_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN cpk_pe ELSE LEAST(cpk_pe,cpk_je) END AS worst_cpk,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN n_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN n_pe WHEN cpk_pe<=cpk_je THEN n_pe ELSE n_je END AS worst_n
  FROM combined
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine",
  n_pe AS "PE Samples", ROUND(cpk_pe::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk (PE)",
  n_je AS "JE Samples", ROUND(cpk_je::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk (JE)",
  ROUND(worst_cpk::NUMERIC,2) AS "Worst Cpk",
  worst_n AS "N (Worst)",
  CASE WHEN worst_cpk IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN COALESCE(worst_n,0)<30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM worst
ORDER BY worst_cpk ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: ◈ Alarm Context (±5 min of clicked timestamp)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
-- resolved: the log_id we're actually trying to center on. NULLIF is
-- applied twice (against '__auto__' AND against '') because a NULL/empty
-- ldi_alarm_log.related_log_id (confirmed live: 3/2960 rows, e.g. a noise
-- alarm with no nearby telemetry, or an upstream link failure) renders as
-- a literal empty string once threaded through Alarm Console's Handlebars
-- template into var-log_id -- without this second NULLIF, target below
-- silently matched zero rows and every downstream CTE cascaded to empty,
-- producing a blank table with no explanation instead of a real NO_DATA
-- state or a working alarm/event list.
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT d0.log_id
      FROM public.ldi_data d0
      WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
        AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
      ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    NULLIF(NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__'), '')
  ) AS log_id
),
target AS (SELECT d."time" FROM public.ldi_data d, resolved r WHERE d.log_id = r.log_id LIMIT 1),
selected_machine AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
 WHERE (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (COALESCE(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC, 0) <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
), alarm_rows AS (
SELECT al.logdate AS "Time",al.equipmentid AS "Machine",al.logid AS "Alarm Event ID",al.errorcode::TEXT AS "Alarm Code",al.errortime::TEXT AS "Error Time",
 COALESCE(m.alarm_msg,al.errorcode::TEXT) AS "Message",m.alarm_detail AS "Detail",COALESCE(m.severity,'UNMAPPED') AS "Severity",
 al.related_log_id AS "Telemetry Event ID",COALESCE(al.link_basis,'nearest') AS "Link Basis"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON al.errorcode::TEXT=m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE al.equipmentid=sm.eqp_id
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
 AND al.logdate BETWEEN (SELECT "time"-INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target) AND (SELECT "time"+INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
)
SELECT "Time", "Machine", "Alarm Event ID", "Alarm Code", "Error Time", "Message", "Detail", "Severity", "Telemetry Event ID", "Link Basis" FROM alarm_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT target."time",sm.eqp_id,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,'No alarm in +/-5 minutes (real data)',NULL::TEXT,'NONE',NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT
FROM target CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm_rows) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ,sm.eqp_id,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,'This alarm has no linked telemetry record (log_id/event_time_ms did not resolve to a real ldi_data row)',NULL::TEXT,'NONE',NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT
FROM selected_machine sm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
ORDER BY "Time" DESC NULLS LAST;

properties.value: Unique ID for this exact alarm occurrence (ldi_alarm_log.logid). Not the alarm type -- the same Alarm Code fires repeatedly; this ID identifies which specific firing this row is.
The alarm type/definition code from the vendor Alarm Master catalog (ldi_alarm_ms_code). Shared by every occurrence of this alarm type. Click to open the Alarm Dictionary.
The linked telemetry snapshot (ldi_data.log_id). See Link Basis: causal = confirmed trigger, nearest = closest reading in time only.

panels.description: Real alarms within +/-5 minutes of the selected ldi_data.log_id event. No data is valid when alarm and telemetry exports do not overlap. Link Basis: causal = the alarm's related telemetry event is the one that actually triggered it; nearest = a background/noise alarm linked to the closest telemetry row in time only, not causally related (see docs/audit/LDI_ALARM_FIDELITY_AUDIT.md).

panels.title: ◈ Event Timeline around Selected Log ID (+/-5 min)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: bounded lookup around a single log_id, +/-5min window per machine (or fleet-wide, if scope_filter='fleet') */
-- resolved: see the Alarm Context panel's identical comment (id 10) --
-- same NULLIF-against-'' guard, same underlying bug (a NULL/empty
-- related_log_id rendering as var-log_id= with no value), same fix.
WITH resolved AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT d0.log_id
      FROM public.ldi_data d0
      WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
        AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
      ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    NULLIF(NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__'), '')
  ) AS log_id
),
target AS (
  SELECT d."time" AS t
  FROM public.ldi_data d, resolved r
  WHERE d.log_id = r.log_id
  LIMIT 1
),
selected_machine AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
 WHERE (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (COALESCE(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC, 0) <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
),
state_rows AS (
  SELECT d."time" AS event_time,
         d.eqp_id,
         d.state,
         LAG(d.state) OVER (PARTITION BY d.eqp_id ORDER BY d."time") AS prev_state
  FROM public.ldi_data d, target
  WHERE (${scope_filter:sqlstring} = 'fleet' OR (
      (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    ))
    AND d."time" BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '20 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
),
events AS (
  SELECT event_time, eqp_id,
         CASE WHEN state THEN 'START' ELSE 'STOP' END AS event_type,
         'ldi_data'::TEXT AS source,
         CASE WHEN state THEN 'Machine started (RUNNING)' ELSE 'Machine stopped (DOWN)' END AS description,
         NULL::TEXT AS severity,
         NULL::TEXT AS alarm_id,
         NULL::TEXT AS event_id
  FROM state_rows, target
  WHERE prev_state IS NOT NULL AND state IS DISTINCT FROM prev_state
    AND event_time BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.logdate, a.equipmentid, 'ALARM', 'ldi_alarm_log',
         COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT),
         m.severity,
         a.logid,
         a.related_log_id
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT, target
  WHERE (${scope_filter:sqlstring} = 'fleet' OR (
      (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
    ))
    AND a.logdate BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
SELECT event_time AS "Event Time", eqp_id AS "Machine", event_type AS "Event Type", source AS "Source", description AS "Description", severity AS "Severity", alarm_id AS "Alarm Event ID", event_id AS "Telemetry Event ID" FROM events
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::TIMESTAMPTZ, sm.eqp_id, 'NONE', NULL::TEXT, 'This alarm has no linked telemetry record (log_id/event_time_ms did not resolve to a real ldi_data row)', NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT, NULL::TEXT
FROM selected_machine sm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target)
ORDER BY "Event Time" DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 100;

properties.value: Unique ID for this exact alarm occurrence (ldi_alarm_log.logid), populated only for ALARM rows. NULL for START/STOP machine-state rows.
The linked telemetry snapshot (ldi_data.log_id) for ALARM rows. NULL for START/STOP machine-state rows.

panels.description: Event Time / Machine / Event Type / Source / Description / Severity around the selected log_id. State rows are LAG-deduplicated to real START/STOP transitions only (raw ldi_data polls every 6-60s, so without dedup the +/-5min window fills with duplicate RUNNING rows and can push real alarms past the LIMIT 100 cap).

panels.title: ◈ Judgment Error (JE1-JE4) + MAX|JE|

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
SELECT ROUND(je_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "JE 1",ROUND(je_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "JE 2",
 ROUND(je_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "JE 3",ROUND(je_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "JE 4",
 ROUND(max_je::NUMERIC,3) AS "Max |JE|",ROUND(je_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "JE Setting",
 CASE WHEN max_je IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_je <= je_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "JE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) AS max_je
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
